hack.root_cause: Private key compromise → malicious contract upgrade → TokenSafe drain + MinterPool abuse
hack.description: IoTeX's ioTube bridge uses a contract on Ethereum. A single externally owned account (EOA) held unchecked upgrade authority over this contract — no multisig, no timelock, no circuit breaker.
